page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head above it and a catchword at the lower right. A narrow strip at the right edge is the edge of the neighbouring page, and faint marks at the lower left are show-through. Neither is transcribed.

main_text.p: grasse, tum quòd potestate per se nimiâ impotentius abuteretur,tum quòdeandem perpetuaret: vereque formidabilem eum omnibus fuisse, cum omnium res, fama, vita denique ipsa, apud ejus tribunal in discrimen vocari possent, & usus doceret, qui ejusce ordinis unum adversum haberet, ei omnes adversos fieri: nec accusator cuiquam apud infestos judices posset deesse. Isto autem tempore, ait idem, Annibalem prætorem creatum vocasse ad se quæstorem, sed hunc pro nihilo id habuisse, tum quod adversæ factionis esset, (erat enim jamdudum in duas factiones Carthago scilla,) tum quòd quæstura tumerer, unde proximus gradus in ordinem potentissimum horum judicum patebat, & jam nunc futuris ordinis istius opibus sefe metiretur: id vero dicit indigne ferentem Annibalem misisse viatorem ad quæstorem prehendendum[?], subduƈtumque in concionem non magis ipsum quàm ordinem judicum accusasse, præ quorum superbiâ atque opibus nec leges quicquam essent, nec magistratus: & cum secundis auribus accipi orationem, & infimorum quoque libertati gravem esse eorum superbiam animadverteret, legem extemplò promulgasse, eamque pertulisse, ut in singulos

page.notes: The right-hand strip is the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed. Faint marks at the lower left ("anu", "gmue", "unou") are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. "prehendendum" is followed by a stroke or dash mark at the line end, uncertain, so [?] is placed after the word. The "scilla" spelling is as printed and was not corrected.
